recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile-first browser dress-up game called “Moonlit Doll Atelier.” The source mechanics are a paper-doll customization loop: a canvas shows a central avatar, the bottom 45% of the screen is a tappable HUD with four tabs, each tab contains item cards, one item is equipped per category, tapping the finish button enters a portrait-approved modal, and the restart button resets selections. Preserve the existing special trap where the third hem/bottom item triggers an irreversible horror state.

The presentation should feel like gothic whimsical fashion in a moonlit cabinet: stitched paper doll, elongated limbs, crooked panels, bats, crescent moons, stitch marks, dusty parchment panels, mourning-rose accents, tarnished-gold highlights, and short readable HUD copy. Use browser-native canvas/CSS/JS with user-gesture-safe audio and mobile portrait actionability.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: mobile-first paper-doll dress-up/customization game with canvas preview and bottom-sheet item picker.
- objective: choose hair/wig, top/bodice, bottom/hem, and accessory/charm items, then use the finish CTA to lock the look and view an approval state.
- input model: pointerdown/touch/click style selection on tab buttons, item cards, finish CTA, restart CTA, and non-UI canvas taps for particles/audio unlock.
- core loop: render animated doll and background, switch category tabs, equip one item per category, provide audio/particle/feedback, optionally finish into GAMEOVER modal and restart.
- fail/friction state: selecting bottom/hem item id 2 triggers the existing irreversible horror mode; otherwise there is no score failure, only outfit completion.

## Protected mechanics
- Preserve the four-category inventory model and one equipped item per category.
- Preserve tab switching, item-card selection, selected-state highlighting, finish-to-GAMEOVER, restart reset, and horror trigger on bottom/hem id 2.
- Preserve canvas animation loop, responsive resize, particle feedback, audio unlock via user gesture, and mobile pointer routing.
- Preserve no numeric scoring, no timed pressure, no collision system, and no level win/loss semantics beyond outfit approval and horror trap.

## Remixed target
Moonlit Doll Atelier is a gothic-whimsical dress-up cabinet inspired by crooked storybook fashion: the player pins wigs, bodices, hems, and charms onto a stitched paper doll under a moonlit workshop. The mechanics remain a dress-up selection loop, but the world, HUD, inventory names, palette, typography, animated background, focal doll silhouette, feedback, and terminal copy are transformed into an eerie fashion atelier.
